approaches.name: e-Government Procurement system for competitive public bidding
approaches.description: The project introduces an e-GP system, with readiness assessment, pilot acquisition and adoption, to shift procurement to electronic competitive bidding. Practices: e-Government Procurement (e-GP) system for competitive bidding; e-GP pilot system for public procurement; e-GP adoption to increase procurement competition; e-GP electronic government procurement system; e-GP pilot with strategy, roadmap and change management.
approaches.why_innovative: New process: electronic procurement replacing paper tenders - cue: 'introducing' | category Operational; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: The PDO-level results indicators are as follows: • PDO Indicator 1: Value Added Tax (VAT) Gross compliance ratio. • PDO Indicator 2: Aggregate annual SOEs report prepared and published by the centralized oversight agency (SOE Commission). • PDO Indicator 3: Share of competitive biddings for procuring organizations using electronic Government Procurement (e-GP).

extra_evidence.text: (b) introducing electronic Government procurement (e-GP); and (c) improving Page 12 of 60 The World Bank Gambia Fiscal Management Development Project (P166695) financial and operational performance of SOEs and reducing the telecom-related fiscal burden.
(ii) the acquisition, implementation and adoption of an e-GP pilot;
Activities to be financed: The sub-component will support: (i) an e-GP readiness assessment to develop an e-GP strategy and roadmap to support implementation;
GPPA will also be supported to promote increased competition in public procurement through the implementation and adoption of e-GP.
Objective: This sub-component supports activities to promote increased competition in public procurement through the implementation and adoption of e-GP.
Activities to be financed: The sub-component on e-GP will support (i) a e-GP readiness assessment and development of and support to the implementation of an e-GP strategy and roadmap;
(ii) the acquisition, implementation and adoption of e-GP pilot;
(iii) advisory services and quality assurance for effective implementation and adoption of e-GP and (iv) a change management and communication strategy for the successful adoption of e-GP.

approaches.name: Integrated Tax Administration System with e-filing, e-payment and data analytics
approaches.description: The project implements a COTS-based ITAS with data warehouse, BI, mobile filing and interfaces to customs and PFM systems, plus online procurement training and ICT mapping. Practices: e-filing and e-payment tax services for taxpayers; Integrated Tax Management System with data warehouse and BI; online public procurement course and certification for procurement professionals; online course certification for procurement professionals; e-filing and e-payment tax administration platform; mobile payment and filing for micro and small taxpayers; interfacing ITAS with ASYCUDA World and IFMIS for data matching; Integrated Tax Administration System with e-filing and e-payment; ICT indicators unit with coverage and infrastructure maps.
approaches.why_innovative: New service: online tax filing and payment channels - cue: 'digital transformation' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: Objective: This sub-component aims to enhance the GRA’s operational effectiveness and achieving digital transformation, including through widespread adoption of electronic filing (e-filing) and electronic payments (e- payments) to improve taxpayer services and transparency.

extra_evidence.text: Online tax services and e-procurement will prepare to support the business continuity in future situations similar to this COVID-19 pandemic.
(ii) the selection and implementation of a new Integrated Tax Management System (ITAS) using a Commercial Off-The Shelf (COTS) package.

This will include the parametrization and customization of the COTS to the needs of GRA using a turnkey solution14 as an implementation strategy, and Data warehouse and Business Intelligence Systems including Mobile payment and filing option for micro and small taxpayers;

(vi) TA on integration/interfacing of the new ITAS system with the existing revenue and PFM systems such as The Automated System for Customs Data (ASYCUDA) World, Integrated Financial Management Information Systems (IFMIS) and other relevant applications for data analytics and matching; and (vii) support on strategic compliance, risk management and specific training on sector and compliance audit techniques.

Contribution to COVID-19 response: the design and implementation of an online public procurement course and certification and adoption of e-GP in pilot ministries will reinforce the government procurement capacity and facilitate business continuity.

Expected outcomes: An increase of competitive bidding for public procurement agencies using electronic Government Procurement through a more effective and transparent public procurement function and an increase in the number of professionals certified in public procurement including women.

Objective: This sub-component aims to enhance the GRA’s operational effectiveness and achieve digital transformation, including through widespread adoption of electronic filing (e-filing) and electronic payments (e- payments) to improve taxpayer services and transparency.
Online tax services and e-procurement will support the business continuity in this COVID pandemic.
(ii) the selection and implementation of a new Integrated Tax Management System (ITAS) using a Commercial Off-The Shelf (COTS) package.

This will include the parametrization and customization of the COTS to the needs of GRA using a turnkey solution17 as an implementation strategy, and Data warehouse and Business Intelligence Systems including Mobile payment and filing option for micro and small taxpayers;

(vi) TA on integration/interfacing of the new ITAS system with existing revenue and PFM systems such as ASYCUDA World, IFMIS and other relevant applications for data analytics and matching; and (vii) support on strategic compliance, risk management, and specific training on sector and compliance audit techniques.

Digitizing tax administration processes through the implementation of an Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) along with online services such as e-Declaration, e-Filing and e-payments for citizens and businesses will facilitate the recovery phase and help the government to maintain key services.
The new tax administration system (once effective) will deliver online 24/7 services to taxpayers and allow for e-filing, e-payment and mobile filing and payment.

(iii) support to strengthen the regulatory framework including: (a) spectrum management and monitoring equipment, (b) infrastructure sharing regulation, (c) reference interconnection offer (RIO) regulation, and (d) license regime harmonization;
